decoded.meaning: A PATH whose last packed record declares 9 payload bytes but only 4 remain in the body. The framing is ragged, so the address has no well-defined last segment. A resolver MUST answer ERROR{tr::path::invalid} (0x0021) rather than truncate, pad, or resolve the prefix.
decoded.note: Not a reject.bin case: reject.bin means DECODE must fail (HARNESS.md §negative cases), and a packed PATH body is opaque to the codec. See description.md.
